## PDF page 493

[Open source PDF](../../../../sources/pdf/grinders%20manual.pdf#page=493)

```text
Hero requires some kind of bonus factor
to make a call, for example, if Villain
played fit-or-fold post-flop, Hero would
win more than his fair share of pots
compensating for the reverse implied
odds and equity disadvantage. There is
also the distinct possibility that a player
behind will elect to squeeze and not
even being able to see the flop will hurt
us massively. We'll cover this idea in
detail as the chapter progresses.

Hero folds
```
